description: pkix-revocation::Error (lib.rs:25) was updated in pass-1 to derive Clone and PartialEq, but Eq was not added. Both field types in the Revoked variant — SerialNumber (derives Eq) and CrlReason (derives Eq) — support it. All other variants are fieldless or hold der::Error. der::Error does not implement Eq, so Eq cannot be derived on the whole enum. The PartialEq-only state is therefore correct for structural reasons. However, this should be explicitly documented with a comment (// der::Error is not Eq, so Eq is not derivable) so the asymmetry between Clone+PartialEq (without Eq) is not mistaken for an oversight in future reviews.
title: pkix-revocation: Error derives PartialEq but not Eq (CrlReason + SerialNumber both support Eq)
